custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new part number that no Part Library entry has and no inventory part uses.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425616 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with an approved line.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425616 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  • Start on work order 1 (Work Orders in the top bar, then open work order 1).
